title: Hangover-Cure Irish Lemongrass Agemono-Deep-Fried
description: A roasted Irish dish featuring lemongrass, pulled cheese, and hungover remedy elements, deep-fried in a crispy agemono coating, suitable for low-glycemic diets.
instructions: Trim the lemongrass stalks, using a vegetable peeler to remove the tough outer layers.
Chop the onion and garlic, then sauté in butter until softened.
Boil the Irish potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork.
Mix the flour and egg to make a paste, then add the agemono batter mix and stir until combined.
Cut the corned beef into small pieces, then toss with the lemongrass, onion, and garlic mixture.
Dip the corned beef mixture into the agemono batter, then coat in shredded cheddar cheese.
Heat about 5cm of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C (350°F).
Deep-fry the agemono-coated corned beef for 4-5 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fried agemono on paper towels, then serve hot with roasted Irish potatoes and shredded cheese.
